text: in cellular energy transformation; ATP is hydrolysed to adenosine diphosphate (ADP) releasing en- ergy stored in phosphate bonds. In addition, extracellular ATP influences many biological processes. ATP is a vasodilator that has been used in varied disorders. The sodium and disodium salts have been used in cerebral and pe- ripheral vascular disorders and also for the treatment of su- praventricular tachycardias, although adenosine (p.1202) is the form generally used as an antiarrhythmic. ATP has also been in- vestigated for use in cachexia in patients with cancer. ◊ Reviews. 1. Agteresch HJ, et al. Adenosine triphosphate: established and po- tential clinical applications.
